hypotheses.justification: Redundant given [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] and [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]. Instances NormedSpace.complexToReal (NormedSpace ℝ E) and FiniteDimensional.complexToReal (FiniteDimensional ℝ E) feed FiniteDimensional.proper_real (priority 900), which gives ProperSpace E, hence CompleteSpace E, and so CompleteSpace (Lp E 2 μ) needed for the Bochner integral in the statement. So the statement still elaborates and is the same true statement; the proof is unchanged, since every use of completeness (Lp integral/integral_inner) finds the instance via this chain. stdOrthonormalBasis only needs FiniteDimensional.
